static_traits.name: Chen Jie
static_traits.social_status: Relationship tension with friends and family after Divorce, Limited social support, often feeling judged or misunderstood in conversations
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; never received psychotherapy in the past; no similar psychological problem history
static_traits.language_features: Able to concretely describe distress and automatic thoughts; rather negative tone, often showing absolute and catastrophic tendencies in expression (e.g. 'no one will like it', 'it will surely fail')

basic_info.main_problem: I keep having overwhelming thoughts that my e-book about animals will not succeed and will get bad reviews, which causes me pain and Self-doubt.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these negative thoughts are hindering the progress of my e-book and affecting my overall physical and mental state.
growth_experiences: Recently divorced: self-trust declined after Divorce, stress spilling into writing, Living alone, reduced sense of social support; Relationship tension with friends and family, often feeling judged or misunderstood when discussing distress; negative thought cycles affecting sleep and diet, causing Distraction at work.

core_beliefs: No one cares about what I want to say

special_situations.event: When sitting alone writing an ebook about animals
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my work cannot be liked or recognized by most people, it equals failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly rehearsing worst outcomes in mind and seeking friends' comfort to ease Anxiety, but often leading to Writer's block
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This book will fail; no one will want to read it

special_situations.event: After a friend gives positive feedback that 'the e-book has potential'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If there is no solid evidence that others genuinely approve, their kind words are not credible
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Negating positive feedback and continuing to seek more reassurance externally
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are just being polite, not genuinely seeing potential

special_situations.event: Thinking about the unsupported writing situation after Divorce and Living alone
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If there is no external support or recognition, one is more likely to fail
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly Self-doubting while writing, reducing investment to avoid 'wasted effort'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will not succeed doing it alone

special_situations.event: At work, is distracted by worry about negative reviews of the e-book
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot gain others' approval or perform perfectly, it shows I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Presets in the mind that others will give bad reviews, hard to focus on current work
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Everyone will think my book is terrible

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be understood and recognized, for works to be truly seen and affirmed
core_conflict.fear: Fear of being judged and rejected, worrying about experiencing Loneliness and failure after a relationship breakdown again
defense_goal: Lowering uncertainty by seeking external reassurance
Avoiding facing possible failure and criticism through Self-doubt and Withdrawal

object_relations.self_representation: An unvalued, failure-prone judged person / author
object_relations.object_representation: Picky, cold others who negate oneself (readers, friends)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor or others emphasize that you have received positive feedback before, or offer a more balanced perspective
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Subconsciously believing the other party is only offering perfunctory comfort and does not truly approve (transference: viewing others as negating evaluators)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: First Empathize with the feeling of being misunderstood, in a gentle, non-confrontational tone; use open-ended questions to invite examples, and gradually calibrate cognition based on concrete evidence.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to recall and state strengths or successful passages in writing
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Worrying that acknowledging strengths brings greater failure risk, thus Turning negative emotions and attacks against the self, reinforcing self-criticism
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Reduces judgmentalness and emphasizes self-compassion; soft tone, helps to distinguish facts from evaluations, gradually accepting a limited positive self-narrative.

manifestations: Falls into negative thought cycles when writing alone
Often feels misunderstood and judged when discussing troubles with friends
outcomes: Decreased motivation and Decline in creativity

manifestations: Repeatedly doubting 'no one cares about what I want to say'
Needs external 'conclusive proof' to believe the work has value

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: When talking about friends' positive comments, believing they are just polite and not genuine
When imagining reader reactions, presumes others will think the work is 'terrible'

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequent Self-doubt: 'who cares about what I say?'
In sessions, overly harsh on her own expression, hard to accept positive feedback

positive_force: Willing to seek counseling and try a more balanced perspective
Once received positive feedback from friends that the e-book 'has potential'
Habit of staying engaged and hardworking in work and life
Able to identify and express one's own negative thoughts and distress
negative_force: Significant cognitive biases like catastrophizing, mind-reading, and predicting the future
Over-reliance on external approval, often negating positive feedback
Weakened social support after Divorce, Increased sense of loneliness
Sleep and diet affected, declining energy and emotion-regulation ability

target_behavior.behavior: Avoidance / stagnation while writing, with repeated Self-doubt
antecedent: Sitting down alone to write an e-book
Thinking about possible evaluation and failure
target_behavior.core_reason: Divorce and Living alone causing Self-efficacy decline, driven by negative cognitive patterns like catastrophizing, mind-reading, and predicting the future
target_behavior.function: Briefly avoiding failure and judgment, temporarily easing Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: E-book progress stalled, creativity and Decreased drive, spreading to Work performance

target_behavior.behavior: Repeatedly seeking comfort and reassurance from friends
antecedent: When strong negative thoughts and Anxiety appear
When talking with friends about the e-book
target_behavior.core_reason: Treating external approval as the main proof of self-worth, negating positive feedback while continuing to seek confirmation
target_behavior.function: Gaining short-term psychological comfort, reducing uncertainty
target_behavior.consequence: Comfort effects are brief, dependence increases, negative thinking persists, overall physical and mental state is harmed
